# This pseudocode represents the functionality of the given Assembly program in an abstract and easy-to-understand form.

# Program Title: 'Hello, World!'

BEGIN_PROGRAM:
    # Save the current state of registers 14 to 12 into a storage area
    SAVE_REGISTERS(14, 12, memory_location_of_register_13)

    # Load the value from register 15 into register 12
    COPY_REGISTER(register_15, register_12)

    # Establish addressability for register 12
    SET_ADDRESSABILITY(base_register=register_12)

    # Allocate a save area in memory and point register 15 to it
    ALLOCATE_MEMORY(save_area, register_15)

    # Update the save area to link back to the previous save area
    STORE_VALUE(memory_location_of_register_13, offset=4, register_15)

    # Update the save area to link forward to the current save area
    STORE_VALUE(register_15, offset=8, memory_location_of_register_13)

    # Update register 13 to point to the current save area
    COPY_REGISTER(register_15, register_13)

    # Display the message "Hello, World!" to the console
    DISPLAY_MESSAGE("Hello, World!")

    # Restore the previous save area by loading its value into register 13
    LOAD_VALUE(memory_location_of_register_13, offset=4, register_13)

    # Restore the previously saved registers 14 to 12
    RESTORE_REGISTERS(14, 12, memory_location_of_register_13)

    # Set register 15 to 0 to indicate successful execution
    SET_VALUE(register_15, 0)

    # Return control to the calling program using the address in register 14
    RETURN_TO_CALLER(register_14)

# Define a save area in memory capable of storing 18 fullword values
DEFINE_MEMORY_AREA(save_area, size=18_fullwords)

END_PROGRAM

HELLO    CSECT
         STM   14,12,12(13)
         LR    12,15
         USING *,12
         LA    15,SAVEAREA
         ST    13,4(,15)
         ST    15,8(13)
         LR    13,15
         WTO   'Hello, World!'
         L     13,4(,13)
         LM    14,12,12(13)
         LA    15,0
         BR    14
SAVEAREA DS    18F
         END   HELLO
